[Bull] Accord Transformer & Switchgear Ltd's discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis suggests an intrinsic value of Rs148 per share, implying a margin of safety of 43.0% against its market price of Rs84.4 [E36 and E37]. This indicates that the stock is undervalued based on fundamental metrics. This could suggest a higher margin of safety and potentially better future performance. This suggests that the stock may be undervalued based on fundamental metrics, providing investors with a strong case for holding the stock.
